payload.title: The web sends lowercase enum values the GraphQL schema rejects (protocol fcrSource 'band', sampling measurementType 'routine' / measurementMethod 'manual_scale', measuredBy a name into a uuid column), and the growth resolver's 30 inputs still carry no validators, so protocol create/edit and every weighing fail from the UI
payload.rule_violated: The client sends the GraphQL enum names; every input property declares a validator
payload.notes: Found by the Feeding tab audit; remainder of PLAT-HIGH-922 for growth.resolver.ts.
narrative: Found by the Feeding tab audit: protocol create/edit and every weighing fail from the UI; measuredBy sends a name into a uuid column.
